post.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and personal information. A verification code will be sent to the provided email address.

post.summary: Authenticate user and get access token
post.description: Logs in a user with email and password. Returns a JWT access token for authenticated requests.

Authenticates using a Google ID token (from Google Sign-In on mobile or web). Creates a new user if none exists for this Google account, or links to an existing account by email. Returns the same JWT access token and refresh token as login.

get.summary: Verify user account with verification code
get.description: Verifies a user's email address using the verification code sent to their email. This endpoint does not require authentication.

post.summary: Refresh access token using a valid refresh token
post.description: Validates the provided refresh token and issues a new access token and refresh token pair. This allows users to maintain their session without re-authenticating.
Sends a password reset email with a secure token to the provided email address. The token is valid for 1 hour.

post.summary: Reset password using the token received via email
post.description: Validates the reset token and updates the user's password. All active refresh tokens are invalidated for security.
Allows an authenticated user to change their password by providing the current password and a new password. All active refresh tokens are invalidated for security.
Generates a new verification code and sends it to the user's email address. The code is valid for 24 hours.

post.summary: Logout user and invalidate refresh token
post.description: Invalidates the user's refresh token to end the session. Requires authentication.

get.description: Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated user. Requires authentication.

post.description: Initiates an email change request. A verification code will be sent to the new email address. Requires authentication.
Confirms the email change using the verification code sent to the new email. All active sessions will be invalidated. Requires authentication.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the user's account (soft delete). Requires password confirmation for security. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a flat list of all categories without nested SubCategories. Returns only basic category information (Id, Name, Description, SubCategoryCount) for lightweight responses. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new category in the system. This endpoint is restricted to Admin users only. Requires Admin role.

get.summary: Get all categories along with their subcategories
get.description: Retrieves the full hierarchical category tree with nested SubCategories. Returns complete parent-child relationships for building tree structures. Requires authentication.
Returns a flat list of all category-subcategory-id mappings for mobile app dropdowns. Public endpoint - no authentication required.
Retrieves a single category by its ID with basic information. Requires authentication.

put.description: Updates an existing category's information. This endpoint is restricted to Admin users only. Requires Admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a category from the system. Categories with existing subcategories cannot be deleted. This endpoint is restricted to Admin users only. Requires Admin role.

get.description: Retrieves all reports that belong to subcategories under the specified category. Requires authentication.
Retrieves all chat sessions for the authenticated user. Returns a list of chat sessions with other users. Requires authentication.

post.description: Opens an existing chat session or creates a new one with another user. Returns the chat session details. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific chat session including participants. Only participants can access the session. Requires authentication.
Retrieves all messages in a specific chat session. Only participants can access messages. Requires authentication.

post.description: Sends a new message in a chat session. Only participants can send messages. The message is delivered via SignalR in real-time. Requires authentication.

put.description: Marks a chat message as read. Only the message recipient can mark messages as read. Requires authentication.

get.description: Returns the VAPID public key for web push subscription. Use this in the frontend when registering for push. No auth required.
Retrieves notifications for the authenticated user with optional filters. Type filter: all/unread/read. Category filter: all/general/matches. Requires authentication.
Retrieves the count of unread notifications. Requires authentication.

put.description: Marks a notification as read. Requires authentication.

post.description: Marks all notifications as read for the authenticated user. Requires authentication.
Registers or updates the device token for push notifications. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all subcategories with their associated category information. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new subcategory under a specified category. This endpoint is restricted to Admin users only. Requires Admin role.

get.description: Retrieves all subcategories that belong to a specific category. Requires authentication.
Retrieves a single subcategory by its ID with associated category information. Requires authentication.

put.description: Updates an existing subcategory's information. This endpoint is restricted to Admin users only. Requires Admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a subcategory from the system. Subcategories with existing posts cannot be deleted. This endpoint is restricted to Admin users only. Requires Admin role.

get.description: Retrieves all reports that belong to the specified subcategory. Requires authentication.
Retrieves a paginated list of all users in the system. Requires Admin role. Supports search filtering by name or email.
Retrieves user details by ID. Users can only view their own profile unless they are an Admin. Requires authentication.
Returns the authenticated user's profile information including name, email, phone, and verification status. Requires authentication.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile information including name, phone, date of birth, gender, and profile picture. Accepts multipart/form-data. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new admin user account. This endpoint is restricted to existing Admin users only. Requires Admin role.

put.description: Allows an Admin to manually verify a user's account. Sets the user's verification status to true. Requires Admin role.

post.description: Uploads a profile picture for the authenticated user. Accepts image files (jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp) up to 5MB. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves all reports created by a specific user with pagination support. Requires authentication.
Retrieves all reports the authenticated user has saved.
